sentences.text: Once upon a time, a mother cat lived in a nice house with three little kids.
The kids were very bad animals who did not like to keep their clothes clean.
One fine morning, the mother wanted to dress the boys for a party with some company.
She put a pretty shirt on Tom Kitten, who was one of the brothers.
She wanted him to look good for the guests who would arrive later that day.
Tom Kitten was a young cat who did not always listen to good advice.
His mother hoped that he would act well while they had company at home.
She told the kids to walk carefully in the garden and not hurt their clothes.
However, Tom Kitten was a strange child who did not care about simple rules.
He ran outside and played near the trees where the ground was full of green plants.
While he walked around the earth, the small ties on his shirt fell off.
His sister tried to help him.
The clothes were simply too large for his small body.
She picked up the items from the floor, but more pieces fell off his arms.
Tom Kitten felt very sad.
His clothes were now broken, and his special things were missing.
He tried to look for them everywhere, but he could not find anything in the garden.
Soon, another bad animal named Puddle-Duck found the bright items on the ground.
She thought that they were lovely little food objects and put them into her mouth.
She did not know that those small pieces belonged to the young cat in the garden.
Tom Kitten continued to search for his lost property, but the search was difficult.
After a short time, the mother came back to the garden to see her children.
When she saw the open shirt, she became extremely angry with the boys.
The ties were missing.
She looked at Tom Kitten and spoke to him with a very big and serious voice.
She told them that they had broken her rules and hurt their afternoon.
She sent them away to their bedroom.
She told them to stay there for the rest of the day.
The poor kids had to walk up the steps.
They sat quietly in the dark room without toys.
They had no way to leave the space because the door was closed behind them.
Although the mother had company later that evening, the bad brothers could not join.
They had to remain away because they did not follow simple rules about their clothes.
The guests came inside the house and enjoyed the evening with the glad mother cat.
Meanwhile, the two brothers sat on the bed and thought about their mistakes today.
They realized that they should have listened to their parent before going outside to play.
Even today, little cats remember that story and try to be good children every single day.
Life in the house returned to normal after the guests finally left for their own homes.
The mother cat checked the bedroom.
She saw that the boys were resting quietly on the bed.
She hoped they had learned a valuable lesson about following rules and keeping clean.
The following morning, the sun rose brightly over the green fields and the quiet village.
Tom Kitten woke up early and promised himself that he would never break his clothes again.
His sister came into the room and smiled at him because everything was calm now.
They went down to the kitchen where the mother had prepared a warm breakfast.
The family sat together at the table and enjoyed their morning meal without any trouble.
From that day forward, the young cats always tried their best to be nice and careful.
They knew that good behavior would bring them joy and keep them safe from problems.
When visitors came to the house, the brothers welcomed them with happy faces and clean clothes.
The mother cat was very proud of her children because they had finally changed their ways.
Every single member of the family lived happily together for many years in that lovely house.
